mapper.insert: insert into activity_spinwin_person (prize_id, activity_id, user_id, user_name, user_avatar, update_date, redpacket_id) values (#{prizeId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{activityId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userAvatar,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{redpacketId,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select:
SELECT sp.id, sp.prize_id, sp.activity_id, sp.user_id, sp.user_name, sp.user_avatar, sp.update_date, pp.prize_grade, pp.prize_name, sa.activity_title FROM activity_spinwin_person sp LEFT JOIN activity_spinwin_prize pp ON sp.prize_id = pp.prize_id LEFT JOIN activity_spinwin_gift sg ON sg.gift_id = pp.gift_id LEFT JOIN activity_spinwin sa ON sa.activity_id = sp.activity_id where 1=1
and sp.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.userName },'%')
and sa.activity_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.activityTitle},'%')
order by sp.update_date desc
